title: Exploratory stock-quant external quality frontier
state: frozen while prerequisite E10d run 30818303255 is in progress and before any E10d or new-candidate external result is observed
scope: Eight previously unevaluated stock Ministral 3 3B quantizations run through the exact frozen E10d native Arm64 serial scorer. The in-flight E10d Q4_K_M cell is reused as the ninth anchor, and its Q4_0 cell is retained as a diagnostic control, only if the complete E10d aggregate passes unchanged.
hypothesis: At least one stock format is non-dominated against Q4_K_M on the three independent external-quality coordinates and package bytes. This quality-size exploration does not make a serving-performance claim and cannot promote a replacement without matched service evidence and a new sealed confirmation.

prerequisite.failure_rule: If the referenced run fails, is incomplete, lacks the named aggregate artifact, or does not independently validate, do not dispatch E11a and do not substitute a rerun. Retain the prerequisite failure first.

quality_contract.adapter: Exact E10d request preparation, tokenizer parity, synthetic preflight, serial exact-token scorer, cache isolation, metrics, per-sample logs, and raw response retention.
quality_contract.dominance: Maximize all three quality coordinates and minimize model size. A point dominates only when it is no worse on every coordinate and strictly better on at least one.
quality_contract.shortlist: Every non-dominated quality-size point advances to matched native service measurement; there is no post-result count cap.

execution.source_and_service: Exact E7c OpenSSL-off b10216 service plus the validated E10b probability_ids response primitive.

negative_result_rule: Retain unsupported quant types, load failures, tokenizer mismatch, preflight failure, cache-policy mismatch, raw-response loss, incomplete cells, low or mixed quality, regression against Q4_K_M or Q4_0, and dominated points without changing models, tasks, samples, metrics, adapter, or dominance.
claim_boundary: E11a can establish only an exploratory external quality-size frontier across nine exact stock Ministral quantizations using the validated E10d serial scorer on native Arm64. It does not establish end-product service performance, promote a replacement model, rewrite the original admission contract, or make energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, cost, mixed-quant, imatrix, pruning, causal-kernel, or other-runtime claims.
